'''Aelids''' were a race of [[Hair/Legends|furry]] ice worms native to the planet [[Khorm/Legends|Khorm]]. They were known for the ability to burrow under the snow and ice. They rarely ate live prey.

Aelids were often used by the native [[Khormai/Legends|Khormai]] as a means of transportation. They could be attracted by a special [[Aelid horn|horn]] call. Riders would actually ride inside the Aelid's mouth using external reins to guide it.
